name: @cubid/wagmi
description: wagmi-facing Cubid integration contracts for EVM React apps.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @cubid/evm build && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @cubid/evm build && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @cubid/evm build && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
